title: .NET Use tool call for next speaker selection
body:
### What feature would you like to be added?

Use the following tool call to select next speaker
```
pubic async Task<string> SelectNextSpeaker(string name, string reason)
```

### Why is this needed?

The LLM-based select next speaker prompt doesn't work well in when conversation language is Chinese, according to the feedback from @JeffreySu 

Provide an option to use tool call might be helpful in mitigating such scenario
